entities.summary: Petr Elfimov (b. 1980-02-15, Mogilev) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Mogilev and Belarus. Known in the fields of belarus, composers & musicians, europe.
